verdict: Clean: cleared with four stars and no fall; the rival (Nyx), the trial (a horde), the ruler (the Salt King, in the Admiral's model tinted) and the gate (Tempo) all played; no console error, every spot reachable, the texts match the Codex (the Salt King rules floor 3).

found.title: A boss that stands between the camera and the hero fades
found.text: In the first pictures the Salt King looked see-through. That is the duel's own rule (duel.ts: a boss that hides the hero fades to a tenth), not a fault: with the hero on its other side it stands in full.
